explanation.headline: FDA's records show bumetanide injection shortage first posted 2017-12-13 and now resolved; current inventory at Corvale East is 1.4 days for 4 mL vials and 5.7 days for 10 mL vials

sentences.text: FDA's shortage history shows bumetanide injection was first posted on 2017-12-13 and is now resolved as of 2026-10-21.

The initial posting involved MSN Laboratories Private Limited, and additional resolved listings include Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals.
FDA inspection 927215 at Zydus Lifesciences Limited ended 2015-05-23 classified VAI, 935 days before the 2017-12-13 posting.
FDA inspection 1106822 at Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. ended 2019-09-10 classified VAI, 636 days after the 2017-12-13 posting.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02.
Corvale East holds 1.4 days of 4 mL vials and 5.7 days of 10 mL vials; Corvale General holds 9 days of 4 mL vials and 13.1 days of 10 mL vials.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Advagen Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
